evidence.quote: To finetune an LLM as an AI assistant for genomic and proteomic information queries, we prepare the training dataset with both real data and synthetic data with a data augmentation policy.
To collect the real data, we use scripts to access the gene information from NCBI pages and rephrase the content of each gene with GPT 3.5 to normal sequence.
To collect the synthetic data, we use the same prompt to ask GPT 3.5 to generate responses for protein-encoding genes.
While for noncoding genes and pseudogenes, we only used the descriptions from NCBI.

We finetuned these models based on both Parameter-Efficient FineTuning (PEFT) technology and full-parameter finetuning technology, and the finetuning setting is consistent with the Supervised Instruct Finetuning (SIFT) approach.
